verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs index says the portal offers SDKs, and an official box/box-typescript-sdk-gen repo exists on GitHub. However, that repo carries a notice that it will no longer get new features, bug fixes or security patches, and no current supported SDK is documented in the pack. Missing for 10: documentation of actively maintained official SDKs and which languages they cover, SDK usage guides or code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
